title: Te Merekara o te Whakamātautau Wahangu
intro: Ka tūtaki koe ki tētahi kōrero mō te wawaotanga mai o te Atua, he kōrero mō te manaakitanga whakamiharo me te parenga kore e taea te kōrero, e haruru tonu ana i roto i te wā. Ka taea e koe te hura ko wai i tūtaki ki tēnei whakamātautau whakamiharo?
clues: I whiwhi ahau i tētahi karere atua i miharo ai ahau
I pātai taku iwi mō tōku parakore i taku hokinga mai me te tamaiti
I whakahaua ahau kia nohopuku i te kōrero mō tētahi wā
Nā te puna wai me ngā tāte ahau i tautoko i ahau i taku whakamātautau
I ruia e tōku Ariki tētahi rākau whakamiharo hei whāngai i ahau
I puta mai tētahi anahera ki ahau i roto i te āhua o tētahi tangata tino tika

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Meriama
Āhia
Hawa
Hera
Khadijah

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whānautanga takitahi i raro i te nikau
Te aro atu ki te matekai whakamate
Te maka ki roto i te poka mura ahi
Te rere atu i tētahi rangatira nanakia
Te tiaki i tētahi taonga tapu
trial.answer: Te whānautanga takitahi i raro i te nikau

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Rākau pāma
Te rakau e mura ana
Temepara kōhatu
Awa o te Nile
Maunga Hinai

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakamātauhia tōku harakore i te wā i kōrero ai taku tamaiti pēpi
I riro ahau hei kuīni whakahonoretia
I whakangaromia tōku iwi e te whiu a te Atua
Nāku i ārahi tōku iwi ki te wikitoria
I puta ake he puna whakamiharo mō ake tonu atu
outcome.answer: I whakamātauhia tōku harakore i te wā i kōrero ai taku tamaiti pēpi

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
